name: Mana
description: You have 2 level-1 spell slots. Expend one to cast a prepared level-1 spell. You regain all expended mana after a Long Rest.

name: Channel Divinity
description: Expend a use for Divine Spark, Turn Undead, or another Cleric Channel Divinity effect. Regain one use after a Short Rest and all uses after a Long Rest.
